title: DemoHLM: From One Demonstration to Generalizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
title_zh: DemoHLM：从单次演示到可泛化的人形机器人移动操作
abstract: Loco-manipulation is a fundamental challenge for humanoid robots to achieve versatile interactions in human environments. Although recent studies have made significant progress in humanoid whole-body control, loco-manipulation remains underexplored and often relies on hard-coded task definitions or costly real-world data collection, which limits autonomy and generalization. We present DemoHLM, a framework for humanoid loco-manipulation that achieves generalization to different robot and object poses from just a single demonstration in simulation. DemoHLM adopts a hierarchy that integrates a low-level universal whole-body controller with high-level manipulation policies for multiple tasks. The whole-body controller maps whole-body motion commands to joint positions and provides omnidirectional mobility for the humanoid robot. The manipulation policies, learned in simulation via our data generation and imitation learning pipeline, command the whole-body controller with closed-loop visual feedback to execute challenging loco-manipulation tasks. Experiments show a positive correlation between the amount of synthetic data and policy performance, underscoring the effectiveness of our data generation pipeline and the data efficiency of our approach. Real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 robot equipped with an RGB-D camera validate the sim-to-real transferability of DemoHLM, demonstrating robust performance under spatial variations across ten loco-manipulation tasks.
abstract_zh: 移动操作是人形机器人在人类环境中实现多样化交互的一项基本挑战。尽管近期研究在人形机器人全身控制方面取得了显著进展，但移动操作仍探索不足，往往依赖硬编码的任务定义或昂贵的真实世界数据收集，限制了自主性和泛化能力。我们提出 DemoHLM，一个仅需仿真中的单次演示即可泛化到不同机器人及物体位姿的人形机器人移动操作框架。DemoHLM 采用分层架构，将底层通用全身控制器与多个任务的高层操作策略相结合。全身控制器将全身运动指令映射为关节位置，为人形机器人提供全向移动能力。操作策略通过我们的数据生成与模仿学习流程在仿真中学习，以闭环视觉反馈指挥全身控制器执行具有挑战性的移动操作任务。实验表明，合成数据量与策略性能呈正相关，突显了我们数据生成流程的有效性以及方法的数据效率。在配备 RGB-D 相机的 Unitree G1 机器人上进行的真实世界实验验证了 DemoHLM 的仿真到现实迁移能力，在十项移动操作任务中展示了在空间变化下的稳健性能。
tldr_zh: 仅需单次仿真演示即可泛化到不同位姿的人形机器人移动操作框架。
cover_zh: 单次演示就够？DemoHLM 让人形机器人泛化到新位姿！
